# Stop Motion

*Ask your Charm for a little film: a car flying off a ramp, a knight riding out of a castle gate. It builds the set in Brick Studio, writes the scene as code, and the film plays right there in the studio. Scrub the timeline and the studio follows; export it as a video.*

Four Applications, one document: Brick Studio is the screen, Stop Motion is the timeline, a code editor holds the scene, and Review keeps your notes on the film (stop where something is wrong, circle it, say what, and your Charm answers each).

// The Shortcut. A driver cruises down a city avenue, grinning, radio on, past storefronts with
// clerks at their counters and neighbors at their windows, vintage cabs, and people on the
// sidewalks who turn their heads as he passes, down a four-lane avenue paved in gray tiles.
// A cat strolls to the corner and steps into his lane. He yanks the wheel left, round the corner onto the cross street, which is
// closed for construction: he smashes through the barriers, hits the site's plank ramp and
// flies, horror turning to joy. The cat scampers back to the curb and watches him go.
// The city stands under its own sky (Brick Studio's sky swatch), and a billboard behind the
// construction site shows a picture Brick Studio ships; ask your Charm to put up one of
// your own from the Drive.
scene({ title: 'The Shortcut', fps: 24 })

// .. the cast ..........................................................................
const car = actor('car', { component: 'car' })
const driver = actor('driver', { part: 'figure', color: 'blue', face: 'grin', hat: { part: 'construction-helmet', color: 'yellow' } })
driver.ride(car, { x: 0, z: 0.5, height: 7 })
const cat = actor('cat', { part: 'cat', color: 'orange' })
const foreman = actor('foreman', { part: 'figure', color: 'orange', legColor: 'dark-gray', face: 'scowl', hat: { part: 'construction-helmet', color: 'white' } })

// .. the car's road: down the avenue, a swerve, the hard left onto the cross street, the ramp
const V0 = 8, START_Z = 112, SEES_Z = 36
const PTS = [[-5, START_Z], [-5, 68], [-5, 35], [-4.5, 29], [-1, 23], [5, 17], [11, 7], [17.5, -3], [22, -7.2], [28, -8], [38, -8], [57.5, -8]]
const LINE = []
for (let i = 0; i < PTS.length - 1; i++) {
  const a = PTS[Math.max(0, i - 1)], b = PTS[i], c = PTS[i + 1], d = PTS[Math.min(PTS.length - 1, i + 2)]
  for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) {
    const u = k / 40, u2 = u * u, u3 = u2 * u
    const cr = (p0, p1, p2, p3) => 0.5 * ((2 * p1) + ((-p0 + p2) * u) + (((2 * p0) - (5 * p1) + (4 * p2) - p3) * u2) + ((-p0 + (3 * p1) - (3 * p2) + p3) * u3))
    LINE.push([cr(a[0], b[0], c[0], d[0]), cr(a[1], b[1], c[1], d[1])])
  }
}
LINE.push(PTS[PTS.length - 1])
const LEN = [0]
for (let i = 1; i < LINE.length; i++) LEN.push(LEN[i - 1] + Math.hypot(LINE[i][0] - LINE[i - 1][0], LINE[i][1] - LINE[i - 1][1]))
const TOTAL = LEN[LEN.length - 1]
const point = (s) => {
  s = Math.max(0, Math.min(TOTAL, s))
  let lo = 0, hi = LEN.length - 1
  while (hi - lo > 1) { const m = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (LEN[m] <= s) lo = m; else hi = m }
  const f = (s - LEN[lo]) / ((LEN[hi] - LEN[lo]) || 1)
  return { x: lerp(LINE[lo][0], LINE[hi][0], f), z: lerp(LINE[lo][1], LINE[hi][1], f) }
}
const heading = (s) => { const a = point(s - 0.8), b = point(s + 0.8); return Math.atan2(-(b.x - a.x), -(b.z - a.z)) * 180 / Math.PI }

// the clock along it: cruising, then his foot finds the gas after the swerve
const SEES = (START_Z - SEES_Z) / V0
const DT = 1 / 240, S = [0]
for (let t = 0, s = 0; s < TOTAL; ) { const v = Math.min(14, V0 + Math.max(0, 3 * (t - SEES - 1.2))); s += v * DT; t += DT; S.push(Math.min(s, TOTAL)) }
const sAt = (t) => S[Math.min(S.length - 1, Math.round(t / DT))]
const when = (test) => { for (let i = 0; i < S.length; i++) if (test(point(S[i]))) return i * DT; return (S.length - 1) * DT }

// the beats, in seconds, from where the car is
const PASS = when((p) => p.z <= 19)          // he passes the cat
const GATE = when((p) => p.x >= 35)          // his bumper meets the barriers
const RAMP = when((p) => p.x >= 52)          // onto the planks
const TAKEOFF = (S.length - 1) * DT          // off the top
const FLIGHT = TAKEOFF + 0.35, JOY = TAKEOFF + 1.6, WATCH = TAKEOFF + 3.6, END = TAKEOFF + 5.8
const CORNER = SEES - 2.2, HOP = SEES - 1.2
console.log('sees', SEES.toFixed(2), 'pass', PASS.toFixed(2), 'gate', GATE.toFixed(2), 'ramp', RAMP.toFixed(2), 'takeoff', TAKEOFF.toFixed(2), 'end', END.toFixed(2))

// the road is tiled a plate deep, its markings flush: the car rides a plate up, then the planks
const ROAD = 1
car.path(0, TAKEOFF, (u, t) => {
  const s = sAt(t), p = point(s), yaw = heading(s), up = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (p.x - 52) / 5.5))
  return { x: p.x, z: p.z, yaw, height: Math.max(ROAD, 6 * up), pitch: 21.8 * Math.min(1, up / 0.15), roll: 0 }
})
const carAt = (t) => {
  if (t <= TAKEOFF) { const p = point(sAt(t)); return { x: p.x, z: p.z } }
  const u = Math.min(1, (t - TAKEOFF) / (END - TAKEOFF)), s = 0.95 * (1 - Math.pow(1 - u, 2.4))
  return { x: 57.5 + (20 * s), z: -8 }
}
// the flight: a jump's arc, the clock slowing toward the top
car.path(TAKEOFF, END, (u, t) => {
  const s = 0.95 * (1 - Math.pow(1 - u, 2.4))
  return { x: 57.5 + (20 * s), z: -8, yaw: -90, height: 6 + arc(s, 55, 58), pitch: 21.8 - (18 * u), roll: -8 * Math.sin(u * Math.PI) }
})

// .. the driver: happy at the wheel, the yank, gritted through the gate, horror, joy ......
driver.path(0, SEES, (u, t) => ({ pose: { leftLeg: 90, rightLeg: 90, leftArm: 50 + (7 * Math.sin(t * 3.1)), rightArm: 50 - (7 * Math.sin(t * 3.1)), head: 6 * Math.sin(t * 1.7) } }))
driver.at(SEES, { face: 'surprised', pose: { leftLeg: 90, rightLeg: 90, leftArm: 50, rightArm: 50, head: 0 } })
      .at(SEES + 0.25, { pose: { leftArm: 72, rightArm: 28, head: -20 } }, 'ease-out')
      .at(PASS + 0.2, { pose: { leftArm: 80, rightArm: 20, head: -30 } }, 'ease-in-out')
      .at(GATE - 0.5, { face: 'scowl', pose: { leftArm: 55, rightArm: 45, head: 0 } }, 'ease-in-out')
      .at(GATE, { face: 'surprised', pose: { leftArm: 60, rightArm: 60, head: 0 } })
      .at(TAKEOFF, { pose: { leftArm: 50, rightArm: 50, head: 0 } })
driver.path(TAKEOFF, JOY - 0.2, (u, t) => ({ pose: { leftArm: 95 + (35 * Math.sin(t * 14)), rightArm: 90 + (35 * Math.sin((t * 13) + 1)), head: 15 * Math.sin(t * 9) } }))
driver.at(JOY - 0.2, { pose: { leftArm: 120, rightArm: 115, head: 0 } })
      .at(JOY + 0.3, { face: 'grin', pose: { leftArm: 158, rightArm: 166, head: 24 } }, 'ease-out')
      .at(JOY + 1.1, { face: 'laugh', pose: { head: 24 } })
      .at(JOY + 1.9, { pose: { head: -16 } }, 'ease-in-out')

// .. the cat: down the sidewalk to the corner, onto the crosswalk into his lane, a jump, back ..
const bob = (t) => 0.35 * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 9))
cat.at(0, { x: -18.2, z: 38, yaw: 0 })
   .at(CORNER, { z: 19 }, 'linear')
   .at(CORNER + 0.3, { yaw: -90 }, 'ease-out')
   .at(HOP, { x: -17.2 }, 'linear')
   .at(HOP + 0.3, { x: -13.6 }, 'linear')
   .at(SEES - 0.2, { x: -6 }, 'ease-out')
   .at(SEES + 0.1, { yaw: -90 })
   .at(SEES + 0.4, { yaw: -180 }, 'ease-out')
   .at(PASS + 0.4, { yaw: -180, x: -6 })
   .at(PASS + 0.6, { yaw: -270 }, 'ease-out')
   .at(PASS + 1.0, { x: -12 }, 'linear')
   .at(PASS + 1.4, { x: -17.6, z: 19 }, 'linear')
   .at(PASS + 1.8, { yaw: -270 })
   .at(PASS + 2.6, { yaw: -440 }, 'ease-in-out')
cat.path(0, END, (u, t) => {
  if (t < CORNER) return { height: 1 + bob(t) }
  if (t < CORNER + 0.3) return { height: 1 }
  if (t < HOP) return { height: 1 + bob(t) }
  if (t < HOP + 0.3) return { height: 1 + (1.2 * Math.sin(((t - HOP) / 0.3) * Math.PI)) }
  if (t < SEES - 0.2) return { height: 1 + bob(t) }
  if (t < PASS - 0.15) return { height: 1 }
  if (t < PASS + 0.35) return { height: 1 + (2.5 * Math.sin(((t - PASS + 0.15) / 0.5) * Math.PI)) }
  if (t < PASS + 0.6) return { height: 1 }
  if (t < PASS + 1.4) return { height: 1 + bob(t * 1.5) }
  return { height: 1 }
})

// .. chance, kept: a seeded draw, so the city is the same on every frame and every play ....
const seeded = (seed) => () => { seed = (seed + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0; let r = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed); r = (r + Math.imul(r ^ (r >>> 7), 61 | r)) ^ r; return ((r ^ (r >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296 }
const R = seeded(1977)
const range = (a, b) => a + ((b - a) * R()), pick = (list) => list[Math.floor(R() * list.length)]
const lim = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v))
const wrap = (a) => ((((a + 180) % 360) + 360) % 360) - 180
const yawTo = (a, b) => Math.atan2(-(b.x - a.x), -(b.z - a.z)) * 180 / Math.PI
// a glance: smooth noise squeezed, so a head holds a look a while, then turns to the next
const glance = (t, k, rate) => { const g = noise((t * rate) + k); return Math.sign(g) * Math.min(1, Math.abs(g) * 2.5) }
// standing still is never still: weight from foot to foot, hands that drift, a look around
const idle = (t, k, e = 1) => {
  const w = noise((t * 0.22) + k)
  return { head: e * 50 * glance(t, k * 3.7, 0.3), leftArm: 6 * noise((t * 0.6) + k + 11), rightArm: 6 * noise((t * 0.55) + k + 23), leftLeg: 8 * Math.max(0, w), rightLeg: 8 * Math.max(0, -w) }
}
// eyes on the car: near it, or anywhere once it has crashed the gate; a neck turns 80 at most
const watch = (t, pos, body, interest) => {
  const cp = carAt(t), dist = Math.hypot(cp.x - pos.x, cp.z - pos.z), reach = t >= GATE ? 60 : 28
  const rel = wrap(yawTo(pos, cp) - body)
  return { w: interest * lim((reach - dist) / 10, 0, 1) * lim((160 - Math.abs(rel)) / 40, 0, 1), head: lim(rel, -80, 80) }
}
const GATE_AT = { x: 38, z: -8 }

// .. the gate: eight barriers across the closed street, on its tiles; the car takes the two in
// his lane, and the two beside them shudder
const BARRIER_X = 38.5, BARRIER_Z = [-14, -10, -6, -2, 2, 6, 10, 14]
const barriers = BARRIER_Z.map((z, i) => {
  const b = actor('barrier-' + (i + 1), { component: 'barrier' })
  b.at(0, { x: BARRIER_X, z, height: ROAD, yaw: 90, pitch: 0, roll: 0 })
  return b
})
const fly = (i, to, spin, tumble, up, rest) => {
  barriers[i].path(GATE, GATE + 1, (u, t) => ({ x: lerp(BARRIER_X, to.x, u), z: lerp(BARRIER_Z[i], to.z, u), height: ROAD + arc(u, up, up * 2) + (rest * u), yaw: 90 + (spin * u), pitch: tumble * u }))
  barriers[i].at(GATE + 1, { x: to.x, z: to.z, height: ROAD + rest, yaw: 90 + spin, pitch: tumble }, 'hold')
}
fly(1, { x: 49, z: -18.5 }, 400, 450, 22, 2.2)
fly(2, { x: 44, z: 5 }, -300, -270, 18, 1.2)
barriers[0].at(GATE, { yaw: 90 }).at(GATE + 0.15, { yaw: 74, x: BARRIER_X + 0.7 }, 'ease-out').at(GATE + 0.5, { yaw: 80 }, 'ease-in-out')
barriers[3].at(GATE, { yaw: 90 }).at(GATE + 0.2, { yaw: 96, roll: 6 }, 'ease-out').at(GATE + 0.5, { roll: 0 }, 'ease-in')

// .. the foreman on the sidewalk by the gate: a scowl, then the wave, then the leap ........
foreman.at(0, { x: 42, z: -19.5, height: 1, yaw: 180 })
foreman.path(0, GATE - 0.9, (u, t) => { const id = idle(t, 88, 0.8); return { pose: { ...id, head: 40 + id.head } } })
foreman.at(GATE - 0.9, { face: 'surprised', pose: { head: 50 } })
foreman.path(GATE - 0.8, GATE - 0.1, (u, t) => ({ pose: { leftArm: 160 + (25 * Math.sin(t * 20)), rightArm: 160 - (25 * Math.sin(t * 20)), head: 50 } }))
foreman.at(GATE - 0.1, { z: -19.5, height: 1, pose: { leftArm: 160, rightArm: 160, head: 50 } })
       .at(GATE + 0.15, { z: -20.6, height: 4 }, 'ease-out')
       .at(GATE + 0.4, { height: 1, pose: { leftArm: 120, rightArm: 120, leftLeg: 20, rightLeg: -20 } }, 'ease-in')
       .at(GATE + 0.9, { pose: { leftArm: 150, rightArm: 150, leftLeg: 0, rightLeg: 0, head: -60 } }, 'ease-out')

// .. the city: a little crowd, each with somewhere to be ...................................
// Each walker has a kind (a commuter late for work, a window-shopper, a tourist, someone on
// the phone, a jogger, a couple talking, a slow stroller), its own stride, swing and bounce, and
// stops of its own: shop windows, the curb waiting for the light, the hot-dog line. They are
// walked here, frame by frame, before the film: each keeps to its side, slows behind someone,
// steps round them when the other lane is clear, and stops to stare when the gate goes.
const FPS = 24, DT_W = 1 / FPS, NF = Math.ceil(END * FPS) + 2
const LANES = { in: 19.45, out: 22.1 }, LIGHT = PASS + 2.8
const DY = (dir) => (dir > 0 ? 180 : 0)
const KINDS = {
  commuter: { v: [2.1, 2.5], stride: [2.0, 2.4], swing: [22, 30], arms: [0.4, 0.6], interest: 0.25 },
  shopper: { v: [0.9, 1.2], stride: [1.3, 1.6], swing: [18, 24], arms: [0.6, 0.9], interest: 1 },
  tourist: { v: [1.0, 1.3], stride: [1.4, 1.7], swing: [20, 26], arms: [0.7, 1.0], interest: 1 },
  phone: { v: [0.8, 1.1], stride: [1.2, 1.5], swing: [14, 20], arms: [0.3, 0.5], interest: 0.15 },
  jogger: { v: [3.8, 4.4], stride: [2.6, 3.0], swing: [42, 52], arms: [0, 0], interest: 0.5 },
  stroll: { v: [0.6, 0.85], stride: [1.0, 1.2], swing: [12, 16], arms: [0.5, 0.7], interest: 1 },
  couple: { v: [1.2, 1.4], stride: [1.5, 1.8], swing: [20, 26], arms: [0.6, 0.8], interest: 1 },
  waiter: { v: [1.3, 1.5], stride: [1.6, 1.8], swing: [22, 26], arms: [0.6, 0.8], interest: 1 },
  customer: { v: [1.2, 1.4], stride: [1.5, 1.7], swing: [20, 24], arms: [0.6, 0.8], interest: 0.8 }
}
const SHIRTS = ['red', 'azure', 'white', 'green', 'yellow', 'pink', 'medium-blue', 'orange', 'lime', 'black', 'tan', 'dark-gray', 'brown', 'blue']
const LEGS = ['black', 'blue', 'tan', 'dark-gray', 'brown', 'black', 'blue']
const HATS = [['hair', ['brown', 'black', 'tan', 'dark-gray', 'yellow']], ['hair', ['brown', 'black', 'dark-gray']], ['pigtails', ['yellow', 'brown', 'black']], ['cap', ['red', 'white', 'black', 'blue']], ['top-hat', ['black']], ['cowboy-hat', ['tan', 'brown']]]
const FACES = ['smile', 'grin', 'lopsided', 'moustache', 'sunglasses', 'freckles', 'beard', 'glasses', 'frown', 'smile', 'grin']
// kind, side (-1 west, 1 east), heading (-1 south, 1 north), where it starts along the avenue
const P = (kind, side, dir, z, more = {}) => ({ kind, side, dir, z, ...more })
const CROWD = [
  P('commuter', -1, -1, 128), P('couple', -1, -1, 106), P('shopper', -1, -1, 80), P('tourist', -1, 1, 50),
  P('phone', -1, -1, 64), P('jogger', -1, -1, 136), P('shopper', -1, 1, 32), P('waiter', -1, -1, 18.4, { lane: 'out' }),
  P('commuter', -1, 1, 78), P('stroll', -1, -1, 40),
  P('commuter', 1, -1, 72), P('shopper', 1, -1, 98), P('couple', 1, 1, 48), P('phone', 1, 1, 80), P('tourist', 1, -1, 118),
  P('jogger', 1, 1, 30), P('waiter', 1, -1, 21.8, { lane: 'out' }), P('stroll', 1, -1, 56),
  P('commuter', 1, 1, -78), P('shopper', 1, 1, -50), P('phone', -1, -1, -30), P('stroll', -1, 1, -66),
  P('customer', 1, 1, -24.6, { lane: 'in' })
]
// what stands on the sidewalks that is not a walker: the cop, the hot-dog cart, the trash cans,
// and the cat, down the curb, waiting at the corner, and back on the curb after
const OBST = [{ x: 20.5, z: 19, hw: 0.7, hd: 1.4, side: 1 }, { x: 19.5, z: -21.5, hw: 2.5, hd: 1.5, side: 1 }]
const catNear = (t) => (t < CORNER ? { x: -18.2, z: 38 - (19 * t / CORNER), hw: 0.6, hd: 1.2, side: -1 } : (t < HOP ? { x: -18.2, z: 19, hw: 1.2, hd: 0.6, side: -1 } : (t > PASS + 1.2 ? { x: -17.6, z: 19, hw: 1.2, hd: 1.2, side: -1 } : null)))
const stopsFor = (w) => {
  const curb = w.side < 0 ? { z: w.dir < 0 ? 18.4 : -18.4, until: LIGHT } : { z: w.dir < 0 ? 20.6 : -24.6, until: Infinity }
  if (w.side > 0 && w.dir < 0) curb.z = 21.8
  curb.kind = 'curb'; curb.face = DY(w.dir)
  const ahead = (z) => (z - w.z) * w.dir >= 0, s = []
  let z = w.z
  for (let k = 0; k < ({ shopper: 3, tourist: 2, stroll: 1, couple: 1 }[w.kind] || 0); k++) {
    z += w.dir * range(4, 14)
    if (Math.abs(z) < 26 || Math.abs(z) > 132 || (ahead(curb.z) && ((curb.z - z) * w.dir) < 3)) break
    const face = w.kind === 'tourist' ? DY(w.dir) + (pick([-1, 1]) * range(60, 150)) : (w.side < 0 ? 90 : -90)
    s.push({ z, dur: w.kind === 'tourist' ? range(2, 4) : range(1.6, 3.4), until: Infinity, kind: 'window', face })
  }
  if (ahead(curb.z)) s.push(curb)
  return s
}
const crowd = []
const enlist = (c, extra = {}) => {
  const K = KINDS[c.kind], hat = pick(HATS)
  const w = { ...c, ...extra, i: crowd.length, k: range(0, 100), v: range(...K.v), stride: range(...K.stride), swing: range(...K.swing), armK: range(...K.arms), ph: range(0, 6.3), bounce: range(0.04, 0.22), interest: K.interest, rx: range(0.1, 0.5),
    shirt: pick(SHIRTS), legs: pick(LEGS), face0: pick(FACES), hat: { part: hat[0], color: pick(hat[1]) } }
  w.prefLane = extra.prefLane || c.lane || K.lane || (w.side < 0 ? (w.dir < 0 ? 'out' : 'in') : (w.dir < 0 ? 'in' : 'out'))
  w.x = w.side * LANES[w.prefLane]; w.laneX = w.x
  w.stops = extra.stops || stopsFor(w)
  w.spd = 0; w.yaw = DY(w.dir); w.d = 0; w.si = 0; w.mode = 'walk'; w.frames = []
  crowd.push(w)
  return w
}
CROWD.forEach((c) => {
  const lead = enlist(c)
  if (c.kind === 'couple') { const mate = enlist(c, { follow: lead, prefLane: lead.prefLane === 'in' ? 'out' : 'in', stops: lead.stops }); lead.mate = mate; mate.mate = lead; mate.v = lead.v; mate.stride = lead.stride * range(0.9, 1.0) }
})
// a figure's body, shoulders to hands across and a stride deep (its box in the studio is roomier)
const boxOf = (yaw) => (Math.abs(Math.sin(yaw * Math.PI / 180)) > 0.7 ? { hw: 0.7, hd: 1.3 } : { hw: 1.3, hd: 0.7 })
for (let f = 0; f < NF; f++) {
  const t = f * DT_W
  const snap = crowd.map((w) => ({ x: w.x, z: w.z, ...boxOf(w.yaw), side: w.side, dir: w.dir, spd: w.spd, moving: w.mode === 'walk', i: w.i }))
  crowd.forEach((w) => {
    w.frames.push({ x: w.x, z: w.z, yaw: w.yaw, d: w.d, spd: w.spd, stop: w.mode === 'stop' ? w.stopKind : null })
    const me = snap[w.i], others = snap.filter((o) => o.i !== w.i && o.side === w.side).concat(OBST.filter((o) => o.side === w.side), [catNear(t)].filter((o) => o && o.side === w.side))
    if (w.mode === 'stop' && t >= w.stopUntil) w.mode = 'walk'
    // the gate: heard here a moment after it goes, nearer sooner; walkers stop and stare
    const gd = Math.hypot(GATE_AT.x - w.x, GATE_AT.z - w.z)
    if (!w.reacted && gd < 36 && t >= GATE + (gd / 40) + w.rx) {
      w.reacted = true; w.reactAt = t; w.reactFace = pick(['surprised', 'surprised', 'laugh', 'grin', 'frown'])
      const to = yawTo(w, GATE_AT)
      if (w.mode === 'walk') { w.mode = 'stop'; w.stopUntil = t + range(1.6, 3.2); w.face = to; w.stopKind = 'gate' } else w.face = w.face + lim(wrap(to - w.face), -40, 40)
    }
    let want = 0, cap = Infinity, vx = 0
    if (w.mode === 'walk') {
      let stop = w.stops[w.si]
      while (stop && ((stop.z - w.z) * w.dir) <= 0.05 && t >= stop.until) { w.si++; stop = w.stops[w.si] }
      if (stop && ((stop.z - w.z) * w.dir) <= 0.05) {
        w.mode = 'stop'; w.stopUntil = stop.dur ? t + stop.dur : stop.until; w.face = stop.face; w.stopKind = stop.kind; w.si++
      } else {
        want = w.v * (1 + (0.12 * noise((t * 0.3) + w.k)))
        const walker = (o) => o.moving !== undefined
        const overlapX = (o, x) => Math.abs(o.x - x) < (me.hw + o.hw - 0.05)
        const clearAt = (x, back, fore) => !others.some((o) => { const a = (o.z - w.z) * w.dir; return overlapX(o, x) && a > -(me.hd + o.hd + back) && a < (me.hd + o.hd + fore) })
        const other = Math.abs(w.laneX - (w.side * LANES.in)) < 0.1 ? w.side * LANES.out : w.side * LANES.in, pref = w.side * LANES[w.prefLane]
        const sliding = Math.abs(w.x - w.laneX) > 0.05
        if (w.follow) {
          // a couple: side by side, but single file behind the other when someone comes the other way
          const L = snap[w.follow.i], along = (L.z - w.z) * w.dir
          const coming = others.some((o) => walker(o) && o.dir !== w.dir && ((o.z - w.z) * w.dir) > -2 && ((o.z - w.z) * w.dir) < 9)
          if (coming) { w.single = true; if (along >= 1.6) w.laneX = L.x }
          else if (w.single && clearAt(pref, 1, 3)) { w.single = false; w.laneX = pref }
          want = Math.max(0, L.spd + lim((along - (w.single ? 2.0 : 0)) * 1.5, -0.8, 0.8))
        }
        if (stop) want = Math.min(want, (Math.max(0, (stop.z - w.z) * w.dir) * 2.5) + 0.15)
        let gap = Infinity, slow = null
        for (const o of others) {
          if (!(overlapX(o, w.x) || overlapX(o, w.laneX))) continue
          const g = ((o.z - w.z) * w.dir) - (me.hd + o.hd)
          if (g > -0.2 && g < gap && !(walker(o) && o.moving && o.dir === w.dir && o.spd >= want - 0.05 && g > 0.6)) { gap = g; slow = o }
        }
        // round someone slower, only into a long clear stretch of the other lane; back once past
        if (!w.follow && !sliding && gap < 3 && slow && (!walker(slow) || slow.dir === w.dir) && Math.abs(w.laneX - pref) < 0.1 && clearAt(other, 3, 12)) w.laneX = other
        else if (!w.follow && !sliding && Math.abs(w.laneX - pref) > 0.1 && clearAt(pref, 0.6, 1.5)) w.laneX = pref
        if (gap < 3) cap = Math.max(0, (gap - 0.35) * 1.5)
      }
    }
    w.spd = Math.max(0, Math.min(w.spd + ((want - w.spd) * Math.min(1, DT_W * 5)), cap))
    if (w.mode === 'stop') w.spd = Math.max(0, w.spd - (DT_W * 4))
    const dz = w.dir * w.spd * DT_W, dx = lim(w.laneX - w.x, -2.5 * DT_W, 2.5 * DT_W)
    if (w.mode !== 'walk') vx = 0
    w.z += dz; w.x += w.mode === 'walk' ? dx : 0; w.d += Math.hypot(dz, w.mode === 'walk' ? dx : 0)
    const goal = (w.mode === 'stop') ? w.face : (w.spd > 0.1 ? yawTo({ x: 0, z: 0 }, { x: dx, z: dz }) : w.yaw)
    w.yaw += lim(wrap(goal - w.yaw), -300 * DT_W, 300 * DT_W)
  })
}
let stalled = 0
crowd.forEach((w) => { let run = 0; w.frames.forEach((fr, n) => { run = (fr.spd < 0.05 && !fr.stop) ? run + 1 : 0; if (run === FPS * 3) { stalled++; console.log('stalled', w.i + 1, w.kind, (n / FPS).toFixed(1), fr.x.toFixed(1), fr.z.toFixed(1)) } }) })
// any two bodies that meet, by the bodies above
let bumps = 0
for (let n = 0; n < NF; n += 2) for (let a = 0; a < crowd.length; a++) for (let b = a + 1; b < crowd.length; b++) {
  const p = crowd[a].frames[n], q = crowd[b].frames[n], bp = boxOf(p.yaw), bq = boxOf(q.yaw)
  if (Math.abs(p.x - q.x) < bp.hw + bq.hw - 0.05 && Math.abs(p.z - q.z) < bp.hd + bq.hd - 0.05) { bumps++; if (bumps < 12) console.log('bump', a + 1, b + 1, (n / FPS).toFixed(1), p.x.toFixed(1), p.z.toFixed(1), q.x.toFixed(1), q.z.toFixed(1)) }
}
console.log('crowd', crowd.length, 'stalled', stalled, 'bumps', bumps)
// each walker walks its route on the studs, in the walk every figure takes: every stretch
// between its stops one walk, arriving when the crowd above has it arrive; facing what it
// stops for, a tourist pointing, a phone held up, a jogger's elbows bent, its eyes on the
// car or on the one it walks with, and on the gate once it has heard it
const MOVING = 0.25 // studs a second: slower is standing
// a route's points, as few as keep it within `tol` studs of where it went
const simplify = (pts, tol) => {
  if (pts.length < 3) return pts
  const a = pts[0], b = pts[pts.length - 1], len = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.z - a.z) || 1
  let far = 0, at = 0
  pts.forEach((p, i) => { const d = Math.abs(((b.x - a.x) * (a.z - p.z)) - ((a.x - p.x) * (b.z - a.z))) / len; if (d > far) { far = d; at = i } })
  return far <= tol ? [a, b] : [...simplify(pts.slice(0, at + 1), tol).slice(0, -1), ...simplify(pts.slice(at), tol)]
}
crowd.forEach((w) => {
  const a = actor('walker-' + (w.i + 1), { part: 'figure', color: w.shirt, legColor: w.legs, face: w.face0, hat: w.hat }).ground()
  w.actor = a
  const first = w.frames[0], arms = { phone: 6, jogger: 30 }[w.kind] // a hand on a phone barely swings
  a.at(0, { x: first.x, z: first.z, yaw: first.yaw }, 'hold')
  if (w.kind === 'jogger') a.at(0, { pose: { leftArm: 65, rightArm: 65 } }, 'hold')
  if (w.kind === 'phone') {
    a.at(0, { pose: { rightArm: 80, head: 20 } }, 'hold')
    if (w.reactAt) a.at(w.reactAt - 0.3, { pose: { rightArm: 80 } }, 'hold').at(w.reactAt, { pose: { rightArm: -31, head: 0 } }, 'ease-out')
  }
  const stretch = (f0, f1) => {
    const route = simplify(w.frames.slice(f0, f1 + 1).map((fr) => ({ x: fr.x, z: fr.z })), 0.3)
    const far = route.slice(1).reduce((sum, p, i) => sum + Math.hypot(p.x - route[i].x, p.z - route[i].z), 0)
    if (far >= 0.8 && ((f1 - f0) * DT_W) >= 0.25) a.walk(f0 * DT_W, route, { until: f1 * DT_W, seed: 'walker-' + (w.i + 1), ...(arms === undefined ? {} : { arms }) })
  }
  let from = null
  w.frames.forEach((fr, n) => {
    const moving = (fr.spd > MOVING) && !fr.stop
    if (moving && (from === null)) from = n
    if (!moving && (from !== null)) { stretch(from, n); from = null }
    if (!fr.stop || ((n > 0) && w.frames[n - 1].stop)) return
    // a stop begun: facing what it stops for (a window, the light, the gate) until it ends
    let end = n
    while ((end + 1 < w.frames.length) && w.frames[end + 1].stop) end++
    const [t0, t1] = [n * DT_W, end * DT_W]
    a.at(t0, { yaw: w.frames[end].yaw }, 'hold')
    if ((w.kind === 'tourist') && (fr.stop === 'window') && ((t1 - t0) > 1)) a.at(t0 + 0.1, { pose: { rightArm: -31 } }, 'hold').at(t0 + 0.5, { pose: { rightArm: 120 } }, 'ease-out').at(t1 - 0.4, { pose: { rightArm: 120 } }, 'hold').at(t1, { pose: { rightArm: -31 } }, 'ease-out')
  })
  if (from !== null) stretch(from, w.frames.length - 1)
  if (w.reactAt) a.at(w.reactAt, { face: w.reactFace })
})
crowd.forEach((w) => {
  if (w.mate) w.actor.look(w.mate.actor, { within: 4, max: 70 })
  else if (w.interest >= 0.5) w.actor.look(car, { within: 28, max: 80 })
  if (w.reactAt) w.actor.look(car, { from: w.reactAt, within: 60, max: 80 })
})

// .. the woman on the cross street, who sees the gate go from ten studs away ..............
const pink = actor('walker-gate', { part: 'figure', color: 'pink', legColor: 'tan', face: 'freckles', hat: { part: 'pigtails', color: 'brown' } }).ground()
pink.at(0, { x: 26, z: 20.5, yaw: -90 }, 'hold').walk(0, [{ x: 26, z: 20.5 }, { x: 26 + (1.3 * GATE), z: 20.5 }], { until: GATE, seed: 'walker-gate' })
pink.at(GATE, { face: 'surprised', pose: { leftArm: -31, rightArm: -31 } }, 'hold').at(GATE + 0.4, { pose: { leftArm: 150, rightArm: 140 } }, 'ease-out')
pink.look(car, { within: 28, max: 80 })
pink.look(car, { from: GATE, within: 60, max: 80 })

// .. the ones who stand: the cop on the corner, the hot-dog man, the crew on the site .......
// each is lifted out of the set where it stands, and only its pose and face are keyed
const cop = actor('cop', { placed: { x: 19, z: 17, level: 1 } })
const vendor = actor('vendor', { placed: { x: 17, z: -20, level: 1 } })
const WPOS = [{ x: 44, z: -40.5 }, { x: 32, z: -38.5 }, { x: 61.5, z: -30 }], WYAW = [0, 180, 90]
const workers = [{ x: 42, z: -42, level: 19 }, { x: 30, z: -40, level: 0 }, { x: 60, z: -32, level: 0 }].map((p, i) => actor('worker-' + (i + 1), { placed: p }))
const COP = { x: 20.5, z: 19 }, COP_YAW = 90, VEN = { x: 19, z: -18.5 }, VEN_YAW = 0
cop.path(0, END, (u, t) => {
  const id = idle(t, 41, 0.8), look = watch(t, COP, COP_YAW, 1)
  const whistle = t > PASS - 0.6 && t < PASS + 1.4, point = t > GATE + 0.3 && t < GATE + 3
  return { pose: { ...id, head: lerp(id.head, look.head, look.w), rightArm: whistle ? 165 + (10 * Math.sin(t * 12)) : (point ? 95 : id.rightArm), leftArm: point ? 20 : id.leftArm } }
})
cop.at(PASS - 0.6, { face: 'surprised' }).at(PASS + 1.4, { face: 'scowl' })
vendor.path(0, END, (u, t) => {
  const id = idle(t, 57, 0.7), look = watch(t, VEN, VEN_YAW, 0.8), busy = t < GATE && noise((t * 0.25) + 3) > -0.1
  return { pose: { ...id, head: lerp(busy ? 15 * noise(t * 0.8) : id.head, look.head, look.w), rightArm: busy ? 55 + (30 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 7))) : id.rightArm + 30, leftArm: busy ? 45 : id.leftArm + 20 } }
})
vendor.at(GATE + 0.4, { face: 'surprised' })
const chop = (t, period, k) => { const p = ((t / period) + k) % 1; return p < 0.7 ? 30 + (130 * (0.5 - (0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * p / 0.7)))) : 160 - (130 * ((p - 0.7) / 0.3)) }
workers.forEach((wk, i) => wk.path(0, END, (u, t) => {
  const id = idle(t, 70 + (i * 9), 1), stopped = t >= GATE + 0.3 + (i * 0.2), rest = noise((t * 0.18) + (i * 4)) > 0.45
  const look = watch(t, WPOS[i], WYAW[i], stopped ? 1 : 0.1), pose = { ...id }
  if (i !== 1) pose.rightArm = (stopped || rest) ? 30 + id.rightArm : chop(t, i ? 0.95 : 1.25, i * 0.3)
  else { pose.leftArm = 60 + (20 * noise(t * 1.1)); pose.rightArm = 60 + (25 * Math.max(0, noise((t * 1.4) + 2))) }
  pose.head = lerp(pose.head, look.head, look.w)
  return { pose }
}))

// .. the cabs: two vintage cabs heading uptown, one in each northbound lane ...............
const cabs = [{ x: 4, z: -18, v: 9 }, { x: 12, z: -63, v: 9.5 }].map((c, i) => {
  const taxi = actor('taxi-' + (i + 1), { component: 'taxi' })
  const cabbie = actor('cabbie-' + (i + 1), { part: 'figure', color: i ? 'dark-red' : 'white', face: i ? 'beard' : 'moustache' })
  cabbie.ride(taxi, { x: 0, z: 0.5, height: 7 })
  cabbie.path(0, END, (u, t) => ({ pose: { leftLeg: 90, rightLeg: 90, leftArm: 55 + (5 * noise((t * 0.7) + (i * 5))), rightArm: 50 + (5 * noise((t * 0.8) + (i * 7))), head: (i ? -20 : 15) + (35 * glance(t, 30 + (i * 11), 0.3)) } }))
  taxi.at(0, { x: c.x, z: c.z, height: ROAD, yaw: 180 }).at(END, { z: c.z + (c.v * END) }, 'linear')
  taxi.sound(0, 'engine', { until: END, volume: 0.2 })
  return taxi
})

// .. the camera: shot by shot, each move ending where the next shot cuts in ................
// One crane down the avenue to his shoulder; then quick cuts: the cat, his face, over his
// shoulder, the corner from on high; the cut to the jump on the instant he leaves the planks,
// the car crossing the screen the same way on both sides of it. Sounds lead the cuts.
camera.cut(0, { orbit: { angle: 0, distance: 40, height: 64 }, target: { actor: car, height: 6 }, fov: 38 }, 'down the avenue')
      .at(4.2, { orbit: { angle: 35, distance: 13, height: 6 }, target: { actor: car, height: 13 }, fov: 52 }, 'ease-in-out')
      .at(CORNER + 0.7, { orbit: { angle: 20, distance: 13, height: 6 } }, 'linear')
      .cut(CORNER + 0.7, { position: { x: -23, z: 4, height: 3 }, target: { actor: cat, height: 3 }, fov: 34 }, 'the cat')
      .at(SEES, { position: { x: -21, z: 4, height: 3 } }, 'linear')
      .cut(SEES, { orbit: { angle: 10, distance: 9, height: 7 }, target: { actor: driver, height: 10 }, fov: 36 }, 'his face')
      .at(SEES + 0.7, { orbit: { angle: 0, distance: 8, height: 7 } }, 'linear')
      .cut(SEES + 0.7, { orbit: { angle: 180, distance: 13, height: 16 }, target: { actor: driver, height: 6 }, fov: 38 }, 'over his shoulder')
      .at(PASS - 0.4, { orbit: { angle: 205, distance: 12, height: 15 } }, 'linear')
      .cut(PASS - 0.4, { position: { x: -4, z: 52, height: 96 }, target: { actor: car, height: 4 }, fov: 40 }, 'the corner')
      .at(GATE - 0.7, { position: { x: 4, z: 46, height: 86 } }, 'linear')
      .cut(GATE - 0.7, { position: { x: 53, z: 20, height: 13 }, target: { actor: car, height: 5 }, fov: 42 }, 'the gate')
      .at(TAKEOFF, { position: { x: 51, z: 20, height: 12 } }, 'linear')
      .cut(TAKEOFF, { orbit: { angle: 160, distance: 19, height: 6 }, target: { actor: car, height: 4 }, fov: 40 }, 'the jump')
      .at(FLIGHT, { orbit: { angle: 150, distance: 20, height: 6 }, target: { actor: driver, height: 8 } })
      .at(TAKEOFF + 1.1, { orbit: { angle: 100, distance: 21, height: 0 }, fov: 30 }, 'ease-in-out')
      .at(WATCH, { orbit: { angle: 94, distance: 20, height: 1 } }, 'linear')
      .cut(WATCH, { position: { x: -25, z: 22, height: 4 }, target: { x: 48, z: -8, height: 22 }, fov: 44 }, 'the cat watches')
camera.shake(GATE, GATE + 0.3, 0.3, 11)
camera.shake(TAKEOFF, TAKEOFF + 0.35, 0.25, 9)

// the scene from above, the corner, the gate and the ramp: a second Brick Studio shows it
view('plan', { plan: { x: -38, z: -38, width: 116, depth: 96 } })

// .. the sound: each following what makes it ..............................................
car.sound(0, 'radio', { until: SEES, volume: 0.7 })
car.sound(0, 'engine', { until: TAKEOFF, volume: 0.35 })
cat.sound(1, 'purr', { until: HOP, volume: 0.8 })
car.sound(SEES - 0.12, 'squeal', { volume: 0.9 })   // heard a few frames before his face
cat.sound(CORNER + 0.55, 'meow', { volume: 0.5 })     // and the cat before we see her
cat.sound(PASS - 0.2, 'meow', { volume: 0.8 })
car.sound(GATE, 'bump', { volume: 1.4 })
car.sound(GATE + 0.05, 'thump', { volume: 0.8 })
car.sound(RAMP, 'thump')
driver.sound(TAKEOFF, 'scream')
car.sound(FLIGHT, 'whoosh', { volume: 0.6 })
cat.sound(WATCH + 0.4, 'meow')

fade.out(END - 1, END - 0.4)
title(END - 0.6, END, 'THE SHORTCUT')

  </app-content>

## Try It

- Press play, or drag along the timeline: the film plays in the studio above.
- Press **Back to the build** in the studio to work on the set: the film waits until you press **Stage again**.
- Press **Add sound** to put a sound from your Drive into the film at the playhead, then drag it along the Sound row to move it.
- Press **Export MP4** to save the film as a video, and **Save** to keep the film itself (its set and its scene) in your Drive; **Open…** brings one back, **New** starts afresh.
- Change the scene: make the car leave the ramp faster, or the camera swing the other way. The timeline changes as you type.
- Add a second Brick Studio below this one, its build empty: it shows the scene's plan, the whole jump from above with every path and where the camera stands.

Or open the chat on this document and ask:

- *Show me the storyboard of the jump.*
- *Start the camera high above the ramp, then drop it behind the car as it takes off.*
- *Add a second car that chases the first one up the ramp.*
- *Build a castle gate in the studio, then film a knight riding out of it.*

The scene's commands, and how the Applications work together, are in [How It Works](charmiq://./How%20It%20Works.md).
